dct_title_s: UA Census Counties, 1990 - District of Columbia
dct_creator_sm: U.S. Department of Commerce, Bureau of the Census, Geography Division
dct_description_sm: This datalayer displays the counties for the District, based on a ground condition of January 1, 1990. The primary legal divisions of most states are termed ''counties.'' Each county and statistically equivalent entity is assigned a three-digit Federal Information Processing Standards code that is unique within the state. These codes are assigned in alphabetical order of county or county equivalent within each state.
